title: Training a Baseline Logistic Regression Model using scikit-learn

cues.en: Welcome to Section three Training, a supervised learning model.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第三章：訓練監督式學習模型。

cues.en: This is Lecture eight training, a baseline logistic regression model using scikit learn.
cues.zh: 這是第八堂課：使用 scikit-learn 訓練基準邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: So I've included the initial logic to load in the data frame and to pre prepare the data as we did in Lecture seven.
cues.zh: 我已加入先前的程式，讀入 DataFrame，並按照第七堂課的方式準備資料。

cues.en: We're going to be implementing the logistic regression model directly from scikit learn.
cues.zh: 我們會直接使用 scikit-learn 的邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: If you'd like to understand the model in more detail, please head over to this URL.
cues.zh: 如果想更深入了解這個模型，請參考這個網址。

cues.en: This is the web page for the model specifically at scikit learn.org.
cues.zh: 這是 scikit-learn.org 上該模型的專屬說明頁。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So to implement the model I can import.
cues.zh: 要使用模型，可以先匯入

cues.en: Scikit learn dot linear model.
cues.zh: sklearn.linear_model

cues.en: And specifically the logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 中的 LogisticRegression。

cues.en: That model.
cues.zh: 也就是這個模型。

cues.en: I would want to initialize the model class and store that as a model variable within Python.
cues.zh: 我會先初始化模型類別，並存成 Python 中的 model 變數。

cues.en: Once I've got that model initialized, I have the ability to train the model, which I'm going to do using the training data that I partitioned in the train test.
cues.zh: 初始化完成後，就能用先前透過 train_test_split 切分出的訓練資料，

cues.en: Split method.
cues.zh: 來訓練模型。

cues.en: So I supply the X train, which are the features the model is going to learn on.
cues.zh: 傳入 X_train，也就是模型要學習的特徵。

cues.en: And then the Y train, which is the target variable, which contains the fraudulent records as yes or no, which the model will learn from and correct itself from.
cues.zh: 還有 y_train，也就是包含是否涉及詐欺的目標變數，模型會據此學習並修正自己。

cues.en: Okay, so let's learn everything.
cues.zh: 好，執行全部程式。

cues.en: Then once that model is trained, I have the ability to make predictions.
cues.zh: 模型訓練完成後，就可以用它

cues.en: From the model.
cues.zh: 進行預測。

cues.en: By saying model dot predict, and I'm going to be predicting on the test set.
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.predict，並針對測試集做預測。

cues.en: So that's the whole dot set that I've kept aside that the model hasn't been trained on.
cues.zh: 這就是先前保留下來、模型沒有用來訓練的資料集。

cues.en: If I were to make predictions on the same data that the model was to be trained on, that would be bad
cues.zh: 如果針對模型訓練時使用的同一份資料做預測，

cues.en: practice from a data mining or statistical perspective, you know, there'd be a lot of bias in there.
cues.zh: 從資料探勘或統計角度來說都不是好做法，因為結果會有很大的偏差。

cues.en: What we'd want to do is use this random holdout set that hasn't been involved in the training process at all.
cues.zh: 我們應該使用完全沒有參與訓練過程的隨機保留集。

cues.en: We evaluate the model on that in order to see how well the model generalizes on unseen data.
cues.zh: 在這份資料上評估模型，才能知道模型對未見資料的泛化表現。

cues.en: That's I to supply the X test.
cues.zh: 因此，要傳入 X_test。

cues.en: And then we can actually inspect those values.
cues.zh: 接著可以實際查看輸出的值，

cues.en: To see.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: So what we're getting is a binary classification output where the model is just predicting ones or zeros, depending on what it knows.
cues.zh: 我們得到的是二元分類輸出，模型會根據學到的資訊，預測為 1 或 0。

cues.en: After being trained.
cues.zh: 也就是訓練後學到的內容。

cues.en: In this case, because the data is extremely imbalanced.
cues.zh: 由於這裡的資料極度不平衡，

cues.en: The model is obviously predicting a lot of zeros.
cues.zh: 模型顯然預測出大量的 0。

cues.en: The the values are being truncated because it's just a massive array.
cues.zh: 因為陣列非常大，所以顯示內容被截斷了。

cues.en: There's, you know, a few thousand of them.
cues.zh: 裡面有好幾千個值。

cues.en: We're not going to be able to visualize them all here.
cues.zh: 這裡無法一次顯示全部。

cues.en: But this is just a sanity check, just to show you that this is what the model is actually returning once we're running.
cues.zh: 不過，這只是一個合理性檢查，讓你知道模型進行

cues.en: Inference.
cues.zh: 推論時，實際傳回的就是這些結果。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then once we've got these classifications that the models made, the next step would be for us to
cues.zh: 取得模型做出的分類後，下一步就是

cues.en: evaluate the performance and the effectiveness of the classification model.
cues.zh: 評估這個分類模型的效能與成效。

cues.en: So one of the ways we do that is through the confusion matrix and the confusion matrix is essentially a cross section between the ground truth.
cues.zh: 其中一種方式是混淆矩陣，它本質上是將真實標籤

cues.en: So the data that we know to be true and then the predictions that the model makes.
cues.zh: 也就是我們知道正確的資料，與模型的預測結果做交叉比較。

cues.en: So it's a cross section between those.
cues.zh: 也就是兩者的交叉統計。

cues.en: And for a binary classification context, which is what we're in now, considering this is a fraud detection problem.
cues.zh: 在二元分類的情境下，也就是目前這個詐欺偵測問題中，

cues.en: The Confusion Matrix reports on the classification performance of the model by looking at four different
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣會透過四個不同的

cues.en: quadrants or cross sections between the ground truth or the target variable, and then the predictions that the model makes.
cues.zh: 象限，交叉比較真實標籤或目標變數與模型預測，來呈現分類效能。

cues.en: We're going to look at that in more detail now.
cues.zh: 接下來會更仔細介紹。

cues.en: But 3 or 4 of the concepts that we're going to look at are true negatives where non fraudulent data
cues.zh: 我們要看的四個概念，首先是真陰性，也就是原本

cues.en: from a ground truth perspective is correctly classified as non fraudulent by the model.
cues.zh: 並非詐欺的資料，被模型正確歸為非詐欺。

cues.en: So what you want to do is essentially see how many non fraudulent.
cues.zh: 也就是查看有多少筆非詐欺

cues.en: Transactions are predicted as such.
cues.zh: 交易，被模型正確判斷為非詐欺。

cues.en: Then false positives are the number of non fraudulent transactions that are incorrectly classified as fraud.
cues.zh: 接著是偽陽性，也就是非詐欺交易卻被錯誤判斷為詐欺的數量。

cues.en: So our model is said, you know, these are fraudulent, but in reality they're actually not.
cues.zh: 模型認為它們是詐欺，但實際上並不是。

cues.en: And you know, there's a cost implication to that which we will explore later as well.
cues.zh: 這也會產生成本，後面還會再討論。

cues.en: Then false negatives are the fraudulent cases that are incorrectly classified as being non fraudulent.
cues.zh: 偽陰性則是實際涉及詐欺，卻被錯誤歸為非詐欺的案例。

cues.en: So those are the ones that are fraud.
cues.zh: 也就是這些交易確實涉及詐欺，

cues.en: But the model never determined as being fraud, so the model effectively missed them.
cues.zh: 但模型沒有判定出來，所以實際上是漏掉了。

cues.en: Then our true positives are the transactions that actually are fraud and that the model correctly classified as fraudulent.
cues.zh: 真陽性則是確實涉及詐欺，而且被模型正確判斷為詐欺的交易。

cues.en: So in this case, we're trying to obviously detect fraud.
cues.zh: 我們的目標顯然就是偵測詐欺。

cues.en: So when we speak of positives, that relates to fraud effectively, while negative refers to non fraudulent
cues.zh: 因此，這裡的陽性指的是詐欺，陰性則指非詐欺，

cues.en: and true relates to correct predictions, whereas false relates to incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 而真代表預測正確，偽代表預測錯誤。

cues.en: And there are a number of performance metrics for classification problems that are derived from the confusion matrix and we will explore those in more detail in section four.
cues.zh: 分類問題有許多效能指標都是從混淆矩陣衍生而來，第四章會更深入探討。

cues.en: Therefore, it is foundational that we understand the confusion matrix well and how it can explain the performance of a classification problem.
cues.zh: 所以，充分了解混淆矩陣，以及它如何說明分類問題的效能，是很重要的基礎。

cues.en: So luckily within scikit learn we can implement the confusion matrix quite easily.
cues.zh: 幸好，在 scikit-learn 裡實作混淆矩陣非常容易。

cues.en: So from within sklearn dot metrics we import.
cues.zh: 從 sklearn.metrics 匯入

cues.en: Confusion matrix.
cues.zh: confusion_matrix。

cues.en: And then we can call the confusion matrix and we then need to supply it with two arguments, the first being the ground truth for the test set.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 confusion_matrix，並傳入兩個參數，第一個是測試集的真實標籤。

cues.en: So that's the actual the labels, the true labels of the unseen data, the unseen test set.
cues.zh: 也就是未見資料、未見測試集的實際正確標籤。

cues.en: We want to effectively evaluate how well the model predicted against those those ground truth variables.
cues.zh: 我們要藉此評估模型預測與真實標籤的符合程度。

cues.en: So the actual predictions of the model is y predict or y pred, and we always supply it in this order.
cues.zh: 模型的實際預測存放在 y_predict，或稱 y_pred，而傳入順序固定如此。

cues.en: So this is ground truth and then this is the classification that the model made.
cues.zh: 先是真實標籤，再來是模型做出的分類。

cues.en: So we can run that and then you'll see we'll get this quadrant that effectively determines false positives,
cues.zh: 執行後，就會得到這個用來呈現偽陽性、

cues.en: true positives, etcetera, in a in a two by two matrix.
cues.zh: 真陽性等結果的 2×2 矩陣。

cues.en: Then we've also got.
cues.zh: 另外，還有

cues.en: This implementation here where we are making use of Matplotlib and Seaborn and effectively adding some
cues.zh: 這種使用 Matplotlib 和 Seaborn 的呈現方式，加入一些

cues.en: window dressing and some additional details to give you a fuller understanding or picture of what the confusion matrix looks like.
cues.zh: 視覺美化與額外資訊，讓你更完整了解混淆矩陣的樣貌。

cues.en: We've got a legend that indicates the number of classes or rather the magnitude of the number of records within that quadrant.
cues.zh: 旁邊的圖例顯示各個象限中紀錄數量的大小。

cues.en: But these would be our true positives.
cues.zh: 這些就是真陽性。

cues.en: So these are cases that were predicted as fraud by the model and the true class or the ground truth was fraud.
cues.zh: 也就是模型預測為詐欺，而且真實類別確實也是詐欺的案例。

cues.en: So these are the fraudsters that we detected.
cues.zh: 這些是我們成功偵測到的詐欺者。

cues.en: Then these are the cases where the model missed the fraudsters effectively.
cues.zh: 這些則是模型漏掉詐欺者的案例。

cues.en: So the model predicted that there were not fraudsters, but in reality they actually were.
cues.zh: 模型預測他們不是詐欺者，但實際上卻是。

cues.en: So these are the 15 that we missed.
cues.zh: 所以，這裡漏掉了 15 筆。

cues.en: Here we've got our false positives, six of them, which is pretty good.
cues.zh: 這裡是偽陽性，共有六筆，表現相當不錯。

cues.en: You know, normally in fraud, you end up with quite a few false positives or that's something that we try to mitigate while trying to maximize the number of fraudulent customers or transactions that
cues.zh: 詐欺偵測通常會產生不少偽陽性，因此我們會盡量降低它們，同時提高能偵測到的詐欺客戶或交易

cues.en: we can detect.
cues.zh: 數量。

cues.en: So these are the cases where the model said, yes, it is fraud, but the ground truth says, no, it isn't.
cues.zh: 這些案例就是模型說「是詐欺」，但真實標籤卻說「不是」的情況。

cues.en: So this model does quite well from that perspective.
cues.zh: 從這個角度看，這個模型表現相當好。

cues.en: And then the largest quadrant in terms of the number of records are the cases where the model predicts
cues.zh: 而紀錄數量最多的象限，則是模型預測為

cues.en: that it's normal or non fraudulent and the ground truth says so.
cues.zh: 正常或非詐欺，而且真實標籤也確實如此的案例。

cues.en: So overall, this this model is performing quite well.
cues.zh: 整體而言，這個模型的表現相當不錯。

cues.en: Obviously, we can improve on this.
cues.zh: 當然，還能進一步改善。

cues.en: This is just a baseline solution.
cues.zh: 目前只是一個基準方案。

cues.en: But as we start that is relatively good and it's it's tending to solve the problem that we're trying to solve.
cues.zh: 不過，作為起點已經算不錯，而且確實朝著我們要解決的問題前進。
